configurePresets.name: desktop-base
configurePresets.description: Qt desktop (macOS) build. Needs CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH pointed at a Qt >= 6.7 macOS kit -- see CMakeUserPresets.json / CLAUDE.md.

configurePresets.name: android-base
configurePresets.description: Android arm64-v8a build. Needs toolchainFile, QT_HOST_PATH, CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT and ANDROID_NDK_ROOT supplied by a preset that inherits this one -- see CMakeUserPresets.json / CLAUDE.md. deprecated warnings are off because both vendored NDK toolchain files (android.toolchain.cmake) call cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.6), which is otherwise a deprecation warning on every configure -- not something we can fix, it's Google's file.
